title: Player Freeze
description: Player Freeze is a plugin designed for staff screenshares that allows staff members to freeze players.
body:
# Player Freeze

Player Freeze is a Paper plugin made for staff screenshares and cheating checks. Staff can freeze players with `/freeze <player>`, preventing them from moving, fighting, breaking or placing blocks, dropping or picking up items, and taking damage.

Frozen players see a configurable on-screen warning and can optionally receive Blindness. If a frozen player logs out, the plugin can automatically run configurable punishment commands. Players can also use `/admit` while frozen, which runs configurable admit commands such as a temporary ban.

## Features

- Freeze and unfreeze players
- Permission-protected staff commands
- `/admit` command for frozen players
- Automatic punishment commands when frozen players log out
- Configurable messages, colors, and hex color support
- Configurable screen title and subtitle
- Optional Blindness effect
- Prevents movement, combat, block interaction, item dropping, item pickup, and damage
- Prevents “Flying is not enabled” kicks while frozen
